# Effects and sound

## Beat fx (`"fx": [...]` on a character beat, at most 6)

| fx | where | what it shows |
|---|---|---|
| dust_land | feet | A puff of dust at the feet on landing. |
| dust_run | feet | Little dust kicks at the feet while running. |
| shockwave | feet | A ground ring and dust blasting out from the feet. |
| speed_lines | body | Speed lines streaming behind the body. |
| aura | body, lingers | A glowing aura round the body that lingers (takes the character's color). |
| stars_dizzy | head | Little stars circling the head. |
| sweat_drop | head | A sweat drop by the head (nervous, tired). |
| anger_mark | head | A comic anger mark by the head. |
| heart | head | Hearts floating up from the head. |
| exclaim | head | A "!" pops above the head. |
| question | head | A "?" pops above the head. |
| afterimage | trail | Fading copies of the body trail the move. |
| slash_arc | trail | A bright arc follows the weapon tip. |
| zzz | head | Floating Zs above a sleeper. |
| sparkle | body | Twinkling sparkles round the body. |
| sparkle_rise | body | Sparkles rising up from the body (vanish, return). |
| tears | head | Tears streaming from the eyes. |
| rope_bind | body | Rope loops binding the arms (captured). |
| cage_drop | feet | Dust and clatter as a cage lands (captured). |
| confetti | head | Colorful confetti bursting above the head. |
| halo | head | A glowing halo over the head (ghost). |
| colour_powder | head | A festival colour-powder burst: pink, yellow, green and blue puffs that bloom above the head and drift down (Holi style). |
| gloom_mist | feet, lingers | Rolling grey-purple mist from the Gloom Horn: slow wide puffs spreading along the floor for about 3 s, low alpha. |
| colour_return | body | Colour comes back: a glow, a ring and rainbow sparkles bursting out (with set_grade from). |
| chilli_smoke | feet, lingers | Red-orange chilli smoke rolling in low and wide for about 3 s, with red specks (beats add the sneezes). |
| whirlpool | feet, lingers | A big spinning whirlpool on the water: rings swirling in and foam spinning round for about 3 s. |
| splash | feet | A water splash: droplets fly up and fall, with a white ring on the surface. |
| visor_beam | head | A thick straight cyan beam shooting forward from the head (Iron Ghoom's visor), with a bright core. |
| avalanche | feet, lingers | An avalanche: big snow puffs and snowball dots rushing in low from behind, for about 3 s. |
| mirror_ripple | body | Silver rings rippling out on a mirror's surface when someone goes through it. |
| crystal_pull | body | Six coloured light streams flying up and away from the wrist (the crystals pulled out of the bracelet). |
| grow_giant | body | A purple flash and swirling purple sparkles all around someone growing huge. |
| giant_blast | body | A huge purple-grey blast with a shockwave ring (Giant Peepa's Gloom Blast). |
| beam_clash | body, lingers | Two energy beams meeting: a bright core with sparks flying out in every direction for about 2 s. |

Hit effects come by themselves from hits, explosions and props; do not list them: impact_small, impact_med, impact_big, block_spark, spark, explosion, smoke, bolt, prop_break, energy_ball, bubble_pop, camera_flash.

Kids audience: comic impact words (POW, BONK, BAM, BOING) pop over hits by themselves; scripts never name them.

## Screen effects (world beats: `"who": "world"`)

| do | params (* required) | what it does |
|---|---|---|
| shake | preset*:small/med/big | Shakes the camera: small, med or big. |
| slowmo | scale*:0.1-1 duration*:0.05-5 easeIn:0-1 easeOut:0-2 | Slow motion for `duration` story seconds at `scale` speed; great on a big hit. |
| freeze | duration*:0.05-3 | Freezes the action for a moment (hitstop) without stopping the video. |
| zoom_punch | amount:0-0.5 dur:0.05-1 | A quick camera punch-in that springs back. |
| flash | color:#rrggbb dur:0.02-1 | A full-screen color flash. |
| fade | to*:black/white dur:0.1-5 dir:out/in | Fades the picture out to black or white (or back in with dir in). |
| desaturate | amount:0-1 dur:0-5 | Drains the color from the picture (sad or dramatic moments). |
| text_pop | text*:text<=16 x:0-1 y:0-1 color:#rrggbb | A big comic word pops up on screen (16 characters at most). |
| caption | text*:text<=80 pos:top/bottom/center dur:0.3-10 | A line of caption text at the top, bottom or center. |
| explosion | x*:0-8000 y:0-2000 | An explosion at a stage position. |
| cut | - | A hard cut in the camera (no params). |

## Sounds

Sounds play by themselves from moves, hits, objects and cards; scripts never name them.

- movement: whoosh, land, land_heavy, step, footstep_soft, footstep_hard, robot_stomp
- hit: punch_light, punch_heavy, kick_light, kick_heavy, block, parry
- weapon: slash, sword_clash
- power: explosion, energy_charge, energy_fire, shockwave
- fight: ko, bell
- comic: pop, boing, slip, bonk, pow, raspberry, slide_whistle, squeak, sprout_spring
- crowd: crowd_cheer, crowd_gasp, giggle_crowd
- story: narrate_chime, sad_sting, heartbeat, card_whoosh, gloom_horn, pirate_horn
- object: bubble_blow, bubble_pop, racket_hit, ball_bounce, door_open, car_pass, clang, ball_kick, splash, windup_click, toot, ding
- magic: sparkle, magic_sparkle, crystal_chime
- voice: gasp, laugh_small, cry_small, bark, bark_small, whimper, growl_soft, pant, sneeze, robot_beep, giggle, ooh
